headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 7, 2026**
article:
The Kansas City Royals dominated the Philadelphia Phillies in a 15-1 victory, with Tyler Tolbert leading the offense with 5 hits, including a home run. Noah Cameron earned the win with 5 strong innings, striking out 7 and allowing just 1 earned run. In other action, the New York Yankees secured a 5-1 victory over the Tampa Bay Rays, with Cam Schlittler pitching 8 strong innings, and José Caballero leading the Yankees' offense with 2 hits, 2 home runs, and 4 RBIs.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Max Rajcic, who has been transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to right elbow soreness for the St. Louis Cardinals. Other injured players include Martín Pérez (left forearm contusion) for the Atlanta Braves, Brandon Woodruff (right shoulder inflammation) for the Milwaukee Brewers, Tomoyuki Sugano (back spasms) for the Colorado Rockies, Seth Halvorsen (right shoulder inflammation) for the Colorado Rockies, Matt Gage (left elbow strain) for the San Francisco Giants, and Ha-Seong Kim (right middle finger inflammation) for the Atlanta Braves.

The New York Mets have made a trade, acquiring right-handed pitcher Matt Seelinger from the Detroit Tigers in exchange for cash. The Mets also made a roster move, but details were not provided.

top_news.title: **Royals Rout Phillies 15-1**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals dominated the Philadelphia Phillies in a lopsided 15-1 victory. Tyler Tolbert led the Royals' offense with 5 hits, including a home run, while Noah Cameron earned the win with 5 strong innings, striking out 7 and allowing just 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **Yankees Take Down Rays 5-1**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees secured a 5-1 victory over the Tampa Bay Rays, with Cam Schlittler pitching 8 strong innings. José Caballero led the Yankees' offense with 2 hits, 2 home runs, and 4 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Nationals Come from Behind to Win 11-12**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals overcame a 5-run deficit to defeat the Houston Astros 11-12 in a thrilling matchup. CJ Abrams led the Nationals' offense with 3 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Mets Edge Braves in Thrilling 7-6 Victory**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets secured a hard-fought win against the Atlanta Braves, with a final score of 7-6. Matt Olson led the Braves' offense with a strong performance, recording 2 hits, 2 home runs, and 3 RBIs in 5 at-bats.

top_news.title: **Cardinals' Rajcic Shifted to 60-Day IL**
top_news.summary: St. Louis Cardinals right-handed pitcher Max Rajcic has been transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to right elbow soreness.

top_news.title: **Mets Acquire RHP Matt Seelinger in Trade**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets have acquired right-handed pitcher Matt Seelinger in a trade with the Detroit Tigers, who received cash in return.
